name: TV Roll
description: The picture rolls faster and faster like an old TV losing its vertical hold, then slows down and locks on the second clip. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: rolls
params.description: Number of frames that roll by

params.name: bar_height
params.description: Height of the bar between the frames

params.name: bar_color
params.description: Color of the bar between the frames
